ev.q: Of 343 company employees who completed a questionnaire and ate luncheon food, 191 (56%) had an illness meeting the case definition.
Of 236 luncheon attendees who ate potato salad, 183 (78%) became ill.
Nineteen (53%) of the residents had illnesses meeting the case definition.
Illness onsets occurred a median of 33 hours after eating the lunch (range: 6--96 hours)
The mean illness duration was approximately 24 hours (range: 3.5--33 hours).
Among ill luncheon attendees, symptoms included nausea (87%), diarrhea (80%), abdominal pain (75%), chills (73%), vomiting (70%), and headache (65%).
Among luncheon attendees, eating potato salad was associated strongly with illness (odds ratio=42.7; 95% confidence interval=18.6--101.7).

public_health_question.v: What were the source and mode of transmission of two 1999 Norwalk-like virus gastroenteritis outbreaks, one foodborne at a catered luncheon in Alaska and one person-to-person in a Wisconsin residence hall?

ev.q: This report presents investigations of a foodborne NLV outbreak in Alaska and person-to-person transmission in Wisconsin.
Outbreaks of Norwalk-like Viral Gastroenteritis --- Alaska and Wisconsin, 1999
This report presents investigations of a foodborne NLV outbreak in Alaska and person-to-person transmission in Wisconsin.
On November 11, questionnaires were e-mailed to 500 company employees; 456 (91%) were returned.
All residents of the involved floor were administered a symptom, event, and food history questionnaire.

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; the populations are company employees and university residence-hall students, and shared living is discussed only as a transmission setting.

level_alternative.reason: A lenient reading could treat 'shared living arrangements' as a housing-type descriptor raised in a recommendation, but it is framed as a transmission setting, not social position.

notes: Two outbreak investigations in one report; only Alaska has an analytic comparison (food-specific OR), while Wisconsin is descriptive (attack rate, symptom percentages, onset clustering). RT-PCR and sequencing confirm cases and link them, so they are not procedures. The CI-vs-1 test is implied rather than stated.
view_issues: Figures 1 and 2 (epidemic curves) are images with no description in the text.
